scripts.dev:chain: docker compose up -d --wait --no-recreate postgres anvil && npm run dev:db:migrate && docker compose run --rm --no-deps contracts-deployer && docker compose run --rm --no-deps local-fixtures
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n "indexer,backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "docker compose up --no-recreate indexer" "npm run dev -w @othelio/backend" "npm run dev -w @othelio/fe"
scripts.dev:indexer:rebuild: docker compose build indexer && docker compose up -d --no-deps --force-recreate indexer
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && npm run dev:chain
scripts.build: npm run build -w @othelio/shared && npm run build -w @othelio/fe && npm run build -w @othelio/backend
